edit.statement: 'Is a grandchild of' replaces 'is a child of' as the inverse of 'is a parent of': A is a parent of B exactly when B is a grandchild of A.
edit.subject: parent_of
edit.original: 'Is a child of' is the inverse of 'is a parent of': A is a parent of B exactly when B is a child of A.
edit.scope: Parenthood between people; only which relation is paired as the inverse of 'is a parent of' changes.

direct.prompt: Which relation is the inverse of 'is a parent of'?
